kjv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

lines.say: Good morning. Look up for a second. This is where help comes from.
lines.small: Look up for a second. This is where help comes from.

lines.say: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills,

lines.say: from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth. Psalm one twenty one, verses one and two.
lines.big: from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

lines.say: Your help isn't coming from the boss, the bank, or the news. It's coming from him.

lines.say: Lord, my help comes from you. Keep my eyes on you today. In Jesus' name, amen.
